item.title: Becoming Madonna has been nominated for 2 FOCAL Awards - Optomen Television
item.description: We are thrilled to announce that Becoming Madonna has been nominated for the Best Use of Footage in a Music Production and Student Jury Award for Most Inspiring Use of Footage categories. This follows its success in winning Best Feature Film at the Ghent Viewpoint Documentary Film Festival.
